record.question: The half-life of a radioactive substance is the time it takes for:
options: half of the nuclei in a sample to decay.
the mass of the substance to become zero.
record.explanation: Answer B: half of the nuclei in a sample to decay.. Half-life is the interval for half the radionuclides in a sample to decay. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
